describe: Spawns round objects from one edge every `every` ms and moves them straight across the canvas, removing them once they leave it. Provides `spawns` for collision rules and `spawn_speed` (1.0) for speed ramps. Doesn't handle collisions.

let.p: if @from == 'top' then vec(random_float(@radius, @game.canvas_w - @radius), -@radius) else if @from == 'bottom' then vec(random_float(@radius, @game.canvas_w - @radius), @game.canvas_h + @radius) else if @from == 'left' then vec(-@radius, random_float(@radius, @game.canvas_h - @radius)) else vec(@game.canvas_w + @radius, random_float(@radius, @game.canvas_h - @radius))

let.v: if @from == 'top' then vec(0.0, sp) else if @from == 'bottom' then vec(0.0, -sp) else if @from == 'left' then vec(sp, 0.0) else vec(-sp, 0.0)

do.to: push(spawns, {id: _next_id, x: p.x, y: p.y, vx: v.x, vy: v.y, r: @radius, kind: @kind})
map(spawns, s => {...s, x: s.x + s.vx * event.dt / 1000.0, y: s.y + s.vy * event.dt / 1000.0})

do.where: s => s.x < -2.0 * s.r or s.x > @game.canvas_w + 2.0 * s.r or s.y < -2.0 * s.r or s.y > @game.canvas_h + 2.0 * s.r
